{{Short description|Russian mathematician (born 1959)}}
'''Ivan Aleksandrovich Panin''' (Иван Александрович Панин, born 2 July 1959 in [[Apatity]], Russia) is a Russian mathematician, specializing in [[algebra]], [[algebraic geometry]], and [[algebraic K-theory]].

==Education and career==
In 1973 he entered boarding school at [[D. K. Faddeev Academic Gymnasium]] and graduated there in 1976<ref>«… и жилось нам там распрекрасно». "... and our life was wonderful there." — quoted in: {{cite journal |url= http://www.spbumag.nw.ru/2003/26/9.shtml |title= Служенье муз не терпит суеты. Член-корреспондент РАН И. А. Панин о жизни в науке The ministry of the muses does not tolerate fuss. Corresponding Member of the Russian Academy of Sciences I. A. Panin on life in science |publisher= Санкт-Петербургский университет )St. Petersburg University) |date= 14 November 2003 |number= 26 (p. 3650) |access-date= 13 August 2020 |archive-date= 3 February 2014 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20140203121744/http://www.spbumag.nw.ru/2003/26/9.shtml |url-status= dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://agym.spbu.ru/gimnaziya/vydayushchiesya-vypuskniki.html|title=Выдающиеся выпускники (Outstanding graduates)|website= Академической гимназии (Academic Gymnasium, agym.spbu.ru)}}</ref> There he graduated in 1981 from the Faculty of Mathematics and Mechanics of [[Saint Petersburg State University]].  At the [[St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Institute of Mathematics of Russian Academy of Sciences]] (abbreviated ПОМИ им. В. А. Стеклова РАН in Russian), he defended in 1984 his thesis for the [[Candidate of Sciences|degree of candidate of physical and mathematical sciences]] (Ph.D.) with supervisor [[Andrei Suslin]]<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=65017|name=Ivan A. Panin}}</ref> and then became employed there as a staff member. Panin received in 1996 the degree of [[Doctor nauk]] from the St. Petersburg Department of Steklov Institute of Mathematics of Russian Academy of Sciences. There in 1999 he became the head of the laboratory of algebra and number theory. In 2003 he was elected a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences in the Department of Mathematical Sciences.<ref name = "Mathnet">[http://www.mathnet.ru/eng/person17453 I. A. Panin on mathnet.ru (English language version)]</ref> In 2018 in Rio de Janeiro he was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Panin, Ivan|chapter=On Grothendieck-Serre conjecture concerning principal bundles|title=''In:'' Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians—Rio de Janeiro 2018|volume=II. Invited lectures|pages=201–221|year=2018|doi=10.1142/9789813272880_0051|isbn=978-981-327-287-3|s2cid=203101257}}</ref>

==Research==
The main directions of I. A. Panin's work are the theory of oriented cohomology on [[algebraic variety|algebraic varieties]], algebraic K-theory of homogeneous varieties, Gersten's conjecture, the Grothendieck-Serre conjecture on [[Principal bundle|principal G-bundles]], and [[Purity (algebraic geometry)|purity in algebraic geometry]].<ref name = " Mathnet "/>

I. A. Panin proved (together with A. L. Smirnov) theorems of the [[Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem#Generalising and specialising|Riemann-Roch type for oriented cohomology theories]]<ref>{{cite web| first1=Ivan |last1=Panin |first2= Alexander|last2= Smirnov|title=Push-forwards in oriented cohomology theories of algebraic varieties|year=2002|url=http://www.math.uiuc.edu/K-theory/0459/}}</ref> and Riemann-Roch type theorems for the [[Adams operation]]. Panin found a proof of Gersten's conjecture in the case of equal characteristic and an affirmative solution (jointly with Manuel Ojanguren) of the "purity" problem for quadratic forms.<ref name="Mathnet"/>

Panin computed the algebraic K-groups of all twisted forms of flag varieties and all principal homogeneous spaces over the inner forms of semisimple [[algebraic group]]s. He, jointly with [[Alexander Merkurjev|A. S. Merkurjev]] and A. R. Wadsworth, generalized, to arbitrary Borel varieties, results proved by David Tao<ref name="Tao1994">{{cite journal|last1=Tao|first1=D.|title=A Variety Associated to an Algebra with Involution|journal=Journal of Algebra|volume=168|issue=2|year=1994|pages=479–520|issn=0021-8693|doi=10.1006/jabr.1994.1241|doi-access=free}}</ref> concerning index reduction formulas for the function fields of involution varieties.<ref name="Knus1998">{{cite book|editor=Knus, Max-Albert|editor-link=Max-Albert Knus|title=The Book of Involutions|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iNDTyyoaLMIC&pg=PA149|date=30 June 1998|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|isbn=978-0-8218-7321-2|page=149}}</ref><ref name = "Mathnet" /><ref name = "Matmekhovtsy">[http://www.math.spbu.ru/Euler/pages/14_2_panin.htm Иван Александрович Панин, Выдающиеся матмеховцы] (Ivan Alexandrovich Panin, Outstanding mathematical mechanician)</ref>
